Rounding to n Significant Figures
Avrunding til N viktige figurer

This process is similar to rounding to decimal places but there are some subtle differences. Denne prosessen ligner avrunding til desimaler, men det er noen subtile forskjeller.

To round a number to \(n\) significant figures we look at the \((n+1)^{th}\) digit in the decimal expansion of the number. For å runde et tall til \ (n \) Viktige tall ser vi på \ ((n+1)^{th} \) sifferet i desimalutvidelsen av tallet.

  • If the \((n+1)^{th}\) digit is 0, 1, 2, 3 or 4 then we : that is, we simply chop to \(n\) places, inserting zeros if necessary before the decimal point. (In other words we neglect the \((n+1)^{th}\) digit and any digits to its right.)
  • If the \((n+1)^{th}\) digit is 5, 6, 7, 8 or 9 then we : we add \(1\) to the \(n^{th}\) decimal place and then chop to \(n\) places, inserting zeros if necessary before the decimal point.

For example For eksempel

\(\qquad\qquad\qquad\begin{aligned} \dfrac{1}{3} &= 0.3333 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 4 significant figures} \\ \pi &= 3.14159 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 6 significant figures}\\ \dfrac{8}{3} &= 2.667 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 4 significant figures}\\ 2136 &= 2000 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 1 significant figure}\\ 36.78 &= 37 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 2 significant figures}\\ 6.2399 &= 6.240 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 4 significant figures} \end{aligned}\) \(\qquad\qquad\qquad\begin{aligned} \dfrac{1}{3} &= 0.3333 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 4 significant figures} \\ \pi &= 3.14159 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 6 significant figures}\\ \dfrac{8}{3} &= 2.667 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 4 significant figures}\\ 2136 &= 2000 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 1 significant figure}\\ 36.78 &= 37 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 2 significant figures}\\ 6.2399 &= 6.240 & \qquad & \mbox{rounded to 4 significant figures} \end{aligned}\)

Example Eksempel

Write down each of these numbers rounded to 4 significant figures: Skriv ned hvert av disse tallene avrundet til 4 viktige tall:

  1. \(0.12345\)
  2. \(-0.44444\)
  3. \(0.5555555\)
  4. \(0.000127351\)
  5. \(25679\)
  6. \(123.456789\)
  7. \(3456543\)

Solution Løsning

  1. \(0.12345\) rounded to 4 significant figures becomes \(0.1235.\)
  2. \(-0.44444\) rounded to 4 significant figures becomes \(-0.4444.\)
  3. \(0.5555555\) rounded to 4 significant figures becomes \(0.5556.\)
  4. \(0.000127351\) rounded to 4 significant figures becomes \(0.0001274.\)
  5. \(25679\) rounded to 4 significant figures becomes \(25680.\)
  6. \(123.456789\) rounded to 4 significant figures becomes \(123.5.\)
  7. \(3456543\) rounded to 4 significant figures becomes \(3457000.\)
